answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 13591 Country: India Title: upto what age can a boy and girl allowed to intermingle? after what age should a boy or girl expected to perform parda? Question: upto what age can a boy and girl allowed to intermingle? after what age should a boy or girl expected to perform parda? Answer ID: 13591 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1101/935=D/1430) When a girl reaches adolescence, which is around nine year of age when she feels tended towards the other sex, she should observe purdah and should not meet strangers (non-mahram). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
